newsitem.title: FINLAND: M-SERLA, METSALIITTO TO FORM FINANCE J/V.
newsitem.headline: M-SERLA, METSALIITTO TO FORM FINANCE J/V.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Metsa-Serla Oy and its parent cooperative Metsaliitto Osuuskunta will set up a financing company, Metsa Finance, to handle the group's financing operations, Metsa-Serla said in a statement on Friday.
Metsa-Serla will subscribe 51 percent of Metsa Finance's 50 million markka share capital and Metsaliitto will hold 49 percent.
Veli-Matti Mynttinen will be managing director of the new company, Metsa-Serla said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
